title: World’s Unusually High Dollar Exposure Risks Fueling Selloff
summary: Sift through the filings of pension funds and insurers around the world and one thing stands out: some of the biggest holders of US assets have little protection against a weaker dollar, leaving the currency at risk of steeper declines if sentiment suddenly turns.

title: Why the World’s Dollar Exposure Risks Fueling a Selloff
summary: Some of the biggest holders of US assets have little protection against a weaker dollar, while struggling to find alternatives if they wish to deleverage. Bloomberg's Mark Cranfield breaks down the risks. (Source: Bloomberg)
